pages.text: The $(bold)Curse-Sealing Bottle$() is a portable curse power container. Wear it in the generic curio slot (the slot shown as Trinket in this pack).$(br2)While worn it banks curse power for you:$(li)$(bold)Curse power is stored in the bottle first$(): regen, loot prizes and refunds all fill the bottle before the curse core$(li)Capacity $(bold)5000$() curse power, shown as a $(bold)durability bar$()$(li)$(bold)Kept on death$(): the stored power lives on the item, separate from your curse pool

With a bottle the $(bold)spending order$() becomes:$(br)$(li)the curse core (temporary storage)$(li)the bottle$(li)the $(l:vault)Curse Vault$() (placed block container)$(li)and only then Goety soul energy (1 curse = 3 soul)$(br2)So the bottle is both a spare battery and the stash least likely to be lost.

It is also a $(bold)fluid container$(): the bottle exposes a fluid handler and can take $(l:residue)Curse Residue$() from a smeltery.$(br2)$(bold)1 mb Curse Residue = 10 curse power$(), a full bottle holds 500 mb = 5000 curse.$(br2)Right-click a smeltery drain with the bottle, or right-click a $(l:vault)Curse Vault$(), to move residue in and out.

pages.title: Recipe
pages.text: The $(bold)Curse-Sealing Bottle$() is made by the $(l:curse_craft)Curse Crafting Ritual$() (JEI shows the same recipe):$(br2)$(bold)Core slot$() (the lantern right above the ore) takes:$(li)1 x Nyarlathotep's Desire$(br2)$(bold)Material slots$() (the other 8 lanterns) take:$(li)1 x Glass Bottle$(li)3 x Boundary Fragment$(li)1 x Seared Soul Glass Pane$(br2)$(bold)Curse cost$(): $(bold)500$() (the ritual drains 10 per tick, about 2.5 seconds)$(br2)Note: the material count must be $(bold)exact$() - one extra item means no match and the ritual will not start. See $(l:curse_craft)Curse Crafting Ritual$() for how to build the structure (that entry has a visualisable sample structure).

pages.title: Core: Nyarlathotep's Desire
pages.text: Put the $(bold)core item$() on the lantern right above the ore (right-click), place the materials on the eight material lanterns, then $(bold)hold the core and right-click the core lantern$() to start.$(br2)The product floats above the core lantern afterwards; right-click to take it.
